protocol.experiment: Observation only CH and Child MOLTs on spelling prompts

features.label: Token "child" in personal or familial contexts

protocol.gate_method: z = (current residual after attention, before post_attention_layernorm - released input_mean[layer]) / input_std[layer]; raw = z @ e_row + e_bias; g = raw when raw > theta and raw > 0, else 0. FP32 gate and low-rank math.
protocol.native_computation: Native MLP and attention remain unchanged; all observation hooks return None. Native unhooked greedy generation is followed by exact-token cached replay.
protocol.timing: A gate at output token CH is measured while processing that already emitted token. The prompt-final position predicts the first answer token. Both are recorded.
protocol.resource: Reuse retained SPAR instance 56698356; separate directory and process; no new rental or lifecycle changes.
protocol.scope: 22 fixed prompts. Exact cheef misspelling retained plus chief comparison. No ablation, steering, probe training or absorption conclusion.
